features.name: Suggest sales lines with Copilot
features.description: Feature that uses Copilot to generate sales order lines based on free text input describing requested items and quantities. Converts unstructured text input to structured output with item numbers and quantities.
caveats: Requires accurate free text input interpretation by Copilot

features.name: Prompt dialogue interface
features.description: Three-stage framework for Copilot features consisting of input mode, generating mode, and output mode. Can handle unstructured, semi-structured, or structured inputs and outputs.
caveats: Input mode can be optionally skipped if all needed data already exists
Unstructured data introduces more uncertainty in interpretation

features.name: Output mode regeneration and iteration
features.description: Users can cycle through multiple AI-generated output versions using carousel functionality, regenerate outputs by retrying generation, discard outputs to start over, or accept outputs to apply them.

features.name: Map e-document lines to purchase order
features.description: Copilot feature that matches lines from e-documents to purchase order lines. Uses structured input data and skips the input mode since all necessary data is already available.
caveats: Requires pre-matched e-document to purchase order

features.name: Marketing text generation with Copilot
features.description: Feature to generate marketing text for items using structured input data including item name and attributes. Users can configure tone, format, and emphasis settings to control output variation.
caveats: Can optionally skip input mode if sufficient data is already available

features.name: AI human-in-the-loop interaction model
features.description: Conceptual framework where Copilot works with the human user to solve tasks rather than taking control. The computer is positioned as a collaborator, not an autonomous agent.

features.name: Building user trust in AI features
features.description: Design approach focused on helping business users develop trust in AI by understanding AI limitations, advantages, and appropriate use cases. Users need mental models of what AI is good for.
caveats: Most business users are not AI experts
Requires user education on AI capabilities and limitations

features.name: Prompt dialogue page type
features.description: A new page type developed for Business Central to encapsulate AI-related experiences. Contains prompt area, prompt options area, content area, and system actions for managing generative AI interactions.
caveats: Partner extensibility for chat is not currently available
Prompt options must use only option fields
Prompt options should not be required

features.name: AI-generated content preview and discard
features.description: Users can preview AI-generated suggestions and either keep or discard them without data persisting if discarded. The system must provide a way to completely undo what AI suggested.
caveats: Requires AL developers to ensure temporary tables are used for generated output
No side effects of generated output should occur

features.name: AI confidence level marking
features.description: When Business Central shows generated information or insights, it marks that information as AI-generated and attaches a confidence level when possible to inform users about the reliability of the information.
caveats: Confidence levels attached only when possible

features.name: Placeholder text and instruction hints
features.description: Instructional text (ghost text or placeholder text) in the prompt area guides users about what kind of input is expected, helping them understand how to interact with the AI feature.

features.name: Prompt options for output customization
features.description: Optional fields in the prompt dialogue that allow users to adjust AI output parameters such as tone of voice or length. Must be optional fields and should not be required.
caveats: Only option fields are allowed in prompt options area
Prompt options should never be required
Users often don't notice options are available

features.name: AI line matching and generation
features.description: AI can match and generate sales lines from e-documents and purchase orders based on context, without requiring user prompt input when context is already present in Business Central.
caveats: Matching follows well-defined rules
Benefit increases with more lines to fill

features.name: Generate system action
features.description: The system action that runs when the user hits generate in the prompt dialogue to produce the AI-generated output.
caveats: Developer must provide AL code for this action
Must follow undo principle to allow user discard

features.name: Cancel system action
features.description: The system action called when the user decides to discard or keep the output from the prompt dialogue.
caveats: Developer must ensure undo/discard clears all traces of output

features.name: Undo principle for prompt dialogues
features.description: Design principle requiring that users can discard AI-generated output and have all traces disappear, with generated data stored only in temporary tables.
caveats: Generated output must only go to temporary tables
No side effects allowed on permanent data

features.name: Prompt guide
features.description: Feature represented by a Spellbook icon that gives users access to suggestions and templates for prompts, organized by category to help users formulate their own prompts.
caveats: Intended to help non-technical users get started with prompting

features.name: Copilot menu on list pages
features.description: A menu available on all list pages that shows all copilot actions defined in that page, both from apps and system.
caveats: Floating overlay can be hidden by users who prefer action bar only

features.name: Floating copilot menu overlay
features.description: An overlay element on list pages that provides one-click access to the topmost copilot action for maximum discoverability.
caveats: Users can hide the floating menu if preferred
Only shows topmost action in floating position

features.name: Analysis assist
features.description: A system-defined prompt action available on all list pages that provides analysis assistance.

features.name: Dialogue prompt actions
features.description: Prompt actions that can be placed in standard dialogues to provide copilot capability in the context of specific workflows.
caveats: Example shown with marketing text feature

features.name: Subpage prompt actions
features.description: Prompt actions that can be placed on subpages and cards, allowing copilot actions in document contexts.
caveats: Entity pages and cards do not yet have copilot menu capability that lists have

features.name: Sparkle action icon
features.description: Recommended icon representation for prompt actions that trigger AI features in the action bar.

features.name: Copilot and AI capabilities page
features.description: An administrative page where users can check and enable copilot and AI capabilities in their Business Central environment.
caveats: Currently only supports English language
Available from version 24 (2024 Wave 1)
